proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.item_save_dc_override
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation shape can model charges, recharge, attunement, and spell grants, but it cannot carry an item-defined fixed save DC for spells cast from the item. Omitting that DC would misstate how Hold Person and Hold Monster resolve when cast from this wand.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "While holding the wand, you can cast one of the spells (save DC 17) on the following table from it."

notes: The unit otherwise fits MagicItemRecord + activation mechanics: action activation, charge_pool 7, dawn recharge 1d6+1, grant_spell_access for Hold Person and Hold Monster, and last-charge destruction. The blocking gap is the fixed item save DC 17.
